title: Excel Keeps Removing Leading Zeros? Fix CSV Imports Properly
description:
Excel can remove leading zeros and change long numeric-looking identifiers when CSV data is interpreted as numbers. This tutorial shows a safer workflow using Data → From Text/CSV → Transform Data → set identifier columns to Text → Close & Load. It also covers Automatic Data Conversions in current Microsoft 365 / Excel 2024, why 15+ digit identifiers are risky, and why custom formatting is not the same as preserving the underlying CSV value.

Sources: Microsoft Support documentation on leading zeros, large numbers, and data import options.
